description:
This webtoon depicts the events that happened during the year off between Age of Youth 1 and 2 drama. The original was a coming-of-age housemate drama showing how university students from all different backgrounds coped with the various struggles and relationships in their lives.   
In the second season, the girls return a year later to their sharehouse Belle Epoque. This webtoon is a project to help connect the two seasons, filling in fans on what happened in between. The webtoon’s main character will be Kang Yina a.k.a Kang Unnie. She left Belle Epoque in pursuit of her own entrepreneurial dreams so she’s no longer a part of the second, a little bit of which was shown in Season 2. But the webtoon will show her journey and relationships with the girls as she finds her own niche. There is one new character introduced in the webtoon as well, named Seunghyun.  
(Source: Drama Beans)

**Original Webtoon:
